subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will logically complete the series.

AB_Z DEF_ G_IX JKL_ M_OV
solution:
Given : AB_Z DEF_ G_IX JKL_ M_OV

By checking options :

Option 1) YGHVN → AB__Y__Z / DEF__G__ / G__H__IX / JKL__V__ / M__N__OV → (It doesn't Follow the pattern) 

Option 2) CYHVN → AB__C__Z / DEF__Y__ / G__H__IX / JKL__V__ / M__N__OV → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 3) CYGWN → AB__C__Z / DEF__Y__ / G__G__IX / JKL__W__ / M__N__OV → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 4) CYHWN → AB__**C**__Z / DEF__**Y**__ / G__**H**__IX / JKL__**W**__ / M__**N**__OV → (It follows the pattern) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c76836dd5a5732cc3a7f5b48ebfa2caf7511b44a809b3497c3b4615b39f35c9.png] 

So, out of all the options "Option - (4)" follows the pattern.

Hence, "**Option 4**" is the correct answer.
